items.statement: Electronic records that meet the electronic records requirements may be used in place of paper records, following the implementation rules for maintained and submitted records, unless paper records are specifically required.
items.quote: Electronic records that meet the requirements of this part may be used in lieu of paper records, in accordance with § 11.2, unless paper records are specifically required.
items.condition: unless paper records are specifically required

items.statement: Keep computer systems (hardware and software), their controls and the related documentation maintained for electronic records and signatures readily available for, and open to, FDA inspection.
items.quote: Computer systems (including hardware and software), controls, and attendant documentation maintained under this part shall be readily available for, and subject to, FDA inspection.

items.statement: For records that must be maintained but are not submitted to FDA, electronic records may be used in place of paper records, or electronic signatures in place of traditional signatures, wholly or partly, provided the electronic records and electronic signatures requirements are met.
items.quote: For records required to be maintained but not submitted to the agency, persons may use electronic records in lieu of paper records or electronic signatures in lieu of traditional signatures, in whole or in part, provided that the requirements of this part are met.
items.condition: records maintained but not submitted; requirements met

items.statement: For records submitted to FDA, electronic records may be used in place of paper records, or electronic signatures in place of traditional signatures, wholly or partly, only if the electronic records and electronic signatures requirements are met and the document or document parts to be submitted are identified in the public docket as a submission type FDA accepts in electronic form.
items.quote: For records submitted to the agency, persons may use electronic records in lieu of paper records or electronic signatures in lieu of traditional signatures, in whole or in part, provided that:
items.condition: records submitted to FDA; requirements met and submission type accepted in docket

items.statement: For records submitted to FDA, when submitting documents electronically to an FDA receiving unit not specified in the public docket, send the paper forms of those documents with the electronic records, since only the paper forms are treated as official.
items.quote: Documents to agency receiving unit(s) not specified in the public docket will not be considered as official if they are submitted in electronic form; paper forms of such documents will be considered as official and must accompany any electronic records.
items.condition: electronic submission to a receiving unit not specified in the docket

items.statement: For records submitted to FDA in electronic form, consult the intended FDA receiving unit on whether to proceed with the electronic submission and on how to do it (for example transmission method, media, file formats and technical protocols).
items.quote: Persons are expected to consult with the intended agency receiving unit for details on how (e.g., method of transmission, media, file formats, and technical protocols) and whether to proceed with the electronic submission.
items.condition: electronic submission to FDA

items.statement: Where closed systems are used to create, modify, maintain or transmit electronic records, apply procedures and controls designed to ensure the records' authenticity, integrity and, when appropriate, confidentiality, and to ensure a signer cannot readily disown a signed record as not genuine.
items.quote: Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records shall employ procedures and controls designed to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and, when appropriate, the confidentiality of electronic records, and to ensure that the signer cannot readily repudiate the signed record as not genuine. Such procedures and controls shall include the following:
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, validate the systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance and the ability to detect invalid or altered records.
items.quote: Validation of systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, be able to produce accurate and complete copies of records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for FDA inspection, review and copying.
items.quote: The ability to generate accurate and complete copies of records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: Where closed systems handle electronic records, contact FDA if there are any questions about FDA's ability to review and copy the electronic records.
items.quote: Persons should contact the agency if there are any questions regarding the ability of the agency to perform such review and copying of the electronic records.
items.condition: if there are questions about FDA review and copying

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, protect records so they can be retrieved accurately and readily throughout the records retention period.
items.quote: Protection of records to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the records retention period.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, restrict system access to authorized individuals.
items.quote: Limiting system access to authorized individuals.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails that independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify or delete electronic records.
items.quote: Use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: In closed systems handling electronic records, ensure changes to records do not hide previously recorded information.
items.quote: Record changes shall not obscure previously recorded information.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: In closed systems handling electronic records, keep audit trail documentation for at least as long as the related electronic records must be kept, and make it available for FDA review and copying.
items.quote: Such audit trail documentation shall be retained for a period at least as long as that required for the subject electronic records and shall be available for agency review and copying.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use operational system checks to enforce the permitted order of steps and events, as appropriate.
items.quote: Use of operational system checks to enforce permitted sequencing of steps and events, as appropriate.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records; as appropriate

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use authority checks so that only authorized individuals can use the system, electronically sign a record, access the operation or computer system input or output device, alter a record, or perform the operation at hand.
items.quote: Use of authority checks to ensure that only authorized individuals can use the system, electronically sign a record, access the operation or computer system input or output device, alter a record, or perform the operation at hand.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use device checks (for example terminal checks) to determine, as appropriate, whether the source of data input or operational instruction is valid.
items.quote: Use of device (e.g., terminal) checks to determine, as appropriate, the validity of the source of data input or operational instruction.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records; as appropriate

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, confirm that people who develop, maintain or use electronic record/electronic signature systems have the education, training and experience to do their assigned tasks.
items.quote: Determination that persons who develop, maintain, or use electronic record/electronic signature systems have the education, training, and experience to perform their assigned tasks.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, establish and follow written policies that hold individuals accountable and responsible for actions initiated under their electronic signatures, to deter falsification of records and signatures.
items.quote: The establishment of, and adherence to, written policies that hold individuals accountable and responsible for actions initiated under their electronic signatures, in order to deter record and signature falsification.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, apply appropriate controls over systems documentation.
items.quote: Use of appropriate controls over systems documentation including:
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the appropriate controls over systems documentation for closed systems handling electronic records, adequately control the distribution of, access to, and use of documentation for system operation and maintenance.
items.quote: Adequate controls over the distribution of, access to, and use of documentation for system operation and maintenance.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

items.statement: As part of the appropriate controls over systems documentation for closed systems handling electronic records, have revision and change control procedures that maintain an audit trail documenting the time-sequenced development and modification of systems documentation.
items.quote: Revision and change control procedures to maintain an audit trail that documents time-sequenced development and modification of systems documentation.
items.condition: closed systems used for electronic records

not_applicable.text: § 11.10 Controls for closed systems.

items.statement: Where open systems are used to create, modify, maintain or transmit electronic records, apply procedures and controls designed to ensure the records' authenticity, integrity and, as appropriate, confidentiality from the point of creation to the point of receipt.
items.quote: Persons who use open systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records shall employ procedures and controls designed to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and, as appropriate, the confidentiality of electronic records from the point of their creation to the point of their receipt.
items.condition: open systems used for electronic records

items.statement: For open systems handling electronic records, include in the procedures and controls the controls required for closed systems, as appropriate, plus additional measures such as document encryption and appropriate digital signature standards, to ensure record authenticity, integrity and confidentiality as necessary under the circumstances.
items.quote: Such procedures and controls shall include those identified in § 11.10, as appropriate, and additional measures such as document encryption and use of appropriate digital signature standards to ensure, as necessary under the circumstances, record authenticity, integrity, and confidentiality.
items.condition: open systems used for electronic records; as appropriate / as necessary
